**Single player only.** Every feature switches off while other players are in your world.

### Install
1. Download `version.dll` below.
2. Put it in `RSDragonwilds\Binaries\Win64\` inside the game folder (Steam: right-click the game → Manage → Browse local files).
3. Start the game, load your world and press `Esc`: click the **DW** icon in the top-right corner.

To uninstall, delete `version.dll` and the `dw-trainer` folder next to it.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` holds the file's checksum; `gh attestation verify version.dll -R gustavczar/dragonwilds-trainer` proves it was built from this tag by GitHub Actions.

---

**Só single player.** Todas as funções desligam enquanto houver outros jogadores no seu mundo.

### Instalação
1. Baixe o `version.dll` abaixo.
2. Coloque em `RSDragonwilds\Binaries\Win64\` dentro da pasta do jogo (Steam: botão direito no jogo → Gerenciar → Procurar arquivos locais).
3. Abra o jogo, carregue o seu mundo e aperte `Esc`: clique no ícone **DW** no canto superior direito.

Para desinstalar, apague o `version.dll` e a pasta `dw-trainer` ao lado dele.
